snippet.title: Amazing New Anomaly Game | Office After Hours Demo | PC
snippet.description:
Amazing New Anomaly Game | Office After Hours Demo | PC
#anomaly #pcgaming #gaming #gameplay #indiegame #demo 

Buy Game - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3265400/Office_After_Hours_Demo/

About This Demo
Office After Hours is a frightening and sometimes humorous spot the difference anomaly game with a mysterious story.

You just want to go home. Why are you still here?
Your boss has insisted on extra overtime and now you're stuck in the office after work. Keep an eye out for strange occurrences and you might find your way home.



Spot anomalies
During your shift, the office will change and you will discover a lot of work, coffee and, if you are lucky, the office pet.



Escape the overwork hell
To escape from Endless Solutions, you must find clues that will give you access to new areas and reveal new secrets.

Can you find all the numbers and collect the story-related items?



Can you escape the demo?
11 Anomalies

Working hours
15-20 minutes (+overtime)
